limitations: Report UUID guards reject malformed scope before cursor/helper access; they do not establish query-level tenant isolation or populated-data parity.
The operating-pilot response contract was exercised through focused ASGI/source tests with a mocked service; no live OIDC or Gateway database was used.

The Directus audit found no further safe collection with direct location lineage. Polymorphic approval, workflow-history, and file-like reads remain unscoped pending a verified lineage contract or populated-source evidence.
